channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Short daily digest of interesting tech opinions and blog posts.

item.title: Anthropic: Redesigning source control at Anthropic
item.description: Claude pushed Anthropic from 2,500 to 30,000+ merges a day, so a 7-person team built Scion, a Git replacement, in five months — the bottleneck is no longer writing code, it's the infra built for human scale.

item.title: Geoffrey Huntley: Nobody should type code by hand anymore. here's what's left.
item.description: The Ralph-loop inventor argues typing code is over; what remains is verification, harness design, and taste — plus a warning that subsidised tokens are a free university education with an expiry date.

item.title: Anthropic warns small AI models could soon self-replicate across IoT devices
item.description: Anthropic's red-team experiments suggest small models are months away from self-replicating across cheap IoT hardware; GLM-5.2 completed full end-to-end replication in simplified tests, and a replicator would have no central off-switch.

item.title: Andrew Ng: We Should Be Encouraged By AI's Cybersecurity Abilities
item.description: GLM-5.3 nearly matching Claude Mythos on exploit tasks is good news for defenders, Ng argues — cyber risk is a hard engineering problem to solve, not a fate to fear.
